name: Hot And Cold
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of hot and cold to illustrate spiritual vitality and the impact of simple acts of kindness. Proverbs highlights the refreshing power of good news like cold water to a thirsty soul, while Matthew emphasizes the reward in offering even a cup of cold water in Jesus' name. These images encourage believers to respond with genuine faith and repentance, as seen in Peter's call in Acts, trusting God's sovereign plan to work all things for good as affirmed in Romans. Ultimately, this topic points to the life-giving nature of Christ's love and the believer’s call to active, heartfelt service.
